title: The Remote village in the hills
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：remote　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 remote 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the cook wrote of ① a remote village in the hills in the menu, and everybody in the canteen said at once that it was ② more remote than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the cook, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the remote ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most remote village in the hills anybody in the canteen had ever seen, or so the menu for September 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too remote to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the guest who had come to help; the remote ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a remote chance of success, and said that no guest in his right mind would call it ⑥ as remote as the chance of success they had once had in the old canteen. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was remote or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the menu. What the line asked for was ⑦ something remote, and nothing besides. The guest from the next canteen called the whole plan ⑧ quite remote; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the menu kept the names of the remote ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, for the whole place, she wrote of another remote village in the hills in the same menu, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more remote than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most remote chance of success in the whole canteen, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the remote ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 偏远（前置定语 a remote village in the hills：1974 年厨子在菜单里记下的那件偏远的村子）
B. adj. 偏远／渺茫（比较级 more remote than：文中两处，一处比山里偏远的村子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 偏远／渺茫（最高级 the most remote：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 偏远（表语 too remote to do：母亲觉得它太偏远，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 渺茫（前置定语 a remote chance of success：叔叔把整件事称作一桩渺茫的机会）
F. adj. 渺茫（同级比较 as remote as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩成功的渺茫机会相比）
G. adj. 渺茫（后置定语 something remote：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 渺茫（受程度副词修饰 quite remote：那位客人的评价）

items.q: a remote village in the hills
the most remote village in the hills anybody
The most remote chance of success in

answers.why: remote 意为“偏远”，1974 年厨子在菜单里记下的是“一件偏远的村子”，此处作前置定语 a remote village in the hills。
remote 意为“偏远”，此处用比较级 more remote than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
remote 意为“偏远”，菜单上 九月 那行字说它是食堂里最偏远的一件，故用最高级 the most remote village in the hills。
remote 意为“偏远”，母亲认为这件东西“太偏远了，谁也用不上”，too remote to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
remote 意为“渺茫”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩渺茫的机会”，此处作前置定语 a remote chance of success。
remote 意为“渺茫”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩成功的渺茫机会一样渺茫”，同级比较用 as remote as。
remote 意为“渺茫”，菜单上那半行字要的是“渺茫的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something remote。
remote 意为“渺茫”，邻食堂来的那位客人认为这套计划“相当渺茫”，quite 修饰原级 remote。
remote 意为“渺茫”，1984 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要渺茫”，故用比较级 more remote than。
remote 意为“渺茫”，母亲 1986 年说的是“整个食堂里最渺茫的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most remote chance of success。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，厨子在菜单里记下了一件偏远的村子。（a remote village in the hills）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更偏远。（more remote than …）
母亲觉得它太偏远，谁也用不上。（too remote to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩渺茫的机会。（a remote chance of success）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩成功的渺茫机会一样渺茫。（as remote as …）
到了 1981 年，菜单上只剩半行字：要的是一件渺茫的东西。（something remote）
answers: In 1974 the cook wrote of a remote village in the hills in the menu.
Everybody said it was more remote than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too remote to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a remote chance of success.
He said nobody would call it as remote as the chance of success they had once had.
By 1981 the menu asked for nothing but something remote.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 remote 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the cook wrote of a remote village in the hills in the menu, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most remote village in the hills in the canteen, or so the menu says.
My mother thought it too remote to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a remote chance of success, and nobody argued with him.
The guest from the next canteen called the plan quite remote, and everybody laughed.
The remote ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
